## Intuitive framing (one sentence)

If one chef seasons every dish from the same spice rack, then "three independent dishes all taste of cumin" is not three confirmations that cumin is fundamental -- it is one spice rack tasted three times. The substrate keeps reporting "orthogonal axes / triple-confirmed / multi-mechanism," but the SAME authoring pipeline generated the graph all three read from. I want to find out which independence claims survive a spice-rack-blind re-test and which collapse.

## The meta-pattern I am attacking

Three of the project's biggest recent wins are INDEPENDENCE claims:
1. 3-axis architecture "EMPIRICALLY ORTHOGONAL" (just ARCHITECTURALLY LOCKED)
2. Reservation C "TRIPLE-CONFIRMED" (PROVISIONAL 1.33x + INTRINSIC 3/3 + DEFINITIVE 2.34x)
3. KP operator "3 INDEPENDENT signal classes converge" (P1 in-degree + P3 SHARES_MATH bisimulation + P4 codebook geometry)

All three are measured on a graph authored by one pipeline. exp_dev ALREADY caught this exact failure mode once today: canonical AAA-3 0.94x was a clique-SIZE authoring artifact, not intrinsic propensity (see KP_P3 note section 2). My claim: that catch was not a one-off -- it is the dominant risk class for ALL three wins above, and the project has no STANDING audit for it. Per the 7th USER-LOCKED rule (always reconsider frameworks, do not lock in prematurely), the freshly-LOCKED 3-axis architecture is exactly what skunkworks should hit hardest.

## INV-1 (highest payoff): Is Reservation C TRIPLE-CONFIRMED, or ONE confound counted three times?

**Hypothesis to kill:** the PROVISIONAL 1.33x, INTRINSIC 3/3, and DEFINITIVE 2.34x are three VIEWS of the same authoring bias (the author tagged certain atoms as tools, then authored SHARES_MATH/USES edges consistent with that tag; every downstream metric that correlates with tool-ness is then circular), NOT three independent confirmations.

**Why the DEFINITIVE 2.34x is not obviously safe:** the defense was "uniform criterion + degree-aware permutation null + bootstrap CI." But a degree-aware permutation null only controls for DEGREE -- it does not control for the fact that the EDGE SET ITSELF encodes which atoms the author considered tools. If tool-ness leaked into edge authoring, permuting labels at fixed degree still measures the leak. The null is the wrong null.

**Falsification cell (POST-rebuild, CPU):** re-author the SHARES_MATH edge set by a criterion BLIND to tool/material status -- e.g. edges from raw operator-cooccurrence or shared-symbol overlap computed mechanically from atom bodies, with the tool/material tag HIDDEN from the edge generator. Re-run the DEFINITIVE excess-ratio test on this label-blind graph.
- If excess ratio stays >= ~1.4x with CI excluding 1.0 -> Reservation C is REAL and survives the spice-rack-blind test. Strong result, paper-grade.
- If it collapses toward 1.0 -> the 2.34x was authoring leak; "TRIPLE-CONFIRMED" downgrades to "consistent-within-one-authoring-pipeline." Paper Section 3 Axis 2 must say so.

Pre-reg the bands BEFORE running (per 11th rule discipline).

## INV-2: KP "3 independent signal classes" -- measure the correlation, do not assert it

**Hypothesis to kill:** P1 (graph in-degree), P3 (SHARES_MATH bisimulation class size), P4 (codebook geometric cluster) are NOT 3 independent signals -- they are 3 reads of one latent "hubness/centrality" factor. Hub atoms have high in-degree AND large bisimulation classes AND dense codebook neighborhoods by construction.

**Cheap test (POST-rebuild, CPU, ~30 min):** for the atoms that P1/P3/P4 each score, compute pairwise rank correlation (Spearman) of the three promotion scores over the shared atom set. Also compute how many of the 24 P1 candidates ALSO appear in P3 classes ALSO appear in P4 archetypes (overlap, not union).
- If pairwise |rho| < ~0.4 and candidate overlap is low -> genuinely independent, "multi-mechanism" stands, this is a real architectural property worth the paper.
- If pairwise rho > ~0.7 or near-total candidate overlap -> "3-of-5 independent mechanisms" is "1 mechanism measured 3 ways"; the 3-of-5 milestone needs a soundness caveat. Either way the answer SHOULD be a measured number in Section 6, not an asserted adjective.

## INV-3 (the kickoff's own provocation, sharpened): SHARES_MATH boolean -> continuous; are the 12 archetype classes threshold artifacts?

**Hypothesis to kill:** SHARES_MATH is currently boolean (edge / no edge). Mathematical equivalence is naturally GRADED (how much math two atoms share is a continuous quantity). The KP P3 HARD-PASS rests on "12 archetype classes >= 10 bar" from coarsest bisimulation on the boolean graph. If SHARES_MATH were continuous, those 12 clean classes may dissolve or re-partition -- in which case the HARD-PASS is a property of the chosen boolean threshold, not of the math.

**Test (POST-rebuild, CPU):** define a continuous shared-math score per atom pair (e.g. Jaccard over shared operators/symbols/typed-dependencies), sweep a threshold tau to binarize, and recompute the coarsest-bisimulation archetype-class count at each tau.
- If the ~12-class structure is STABLE across a wide tau band (a plateau, like the two-vector-alpha wide robust plateau already in memory) -> the classes are real, boolean is a fine approximation, KP P3 stands AND we gain a "continuous SHARES_MATH" generalization for the paper.
- If 12 classes appear only in a narrow tau window around the authored threshold -> KP P3 is threshold-tuned; reclassify as MIDDLE pending a robustness band.

This also feeds a possible architectural upgrade: continuous-valued SHARES_MATH with a robustness-plateau-justified default tau, analogous to how two_vector alpha=0.5 was justified by its wide plateau rather than asserted.

## Proposed standing methodology-rule candidate (Research to weigh, 1st appearance)

`meta::RULE_independence_claims_require_authoring_blind_null` -- any claim of the form "N independent axes / confirmations / mechanisms" measured on an authored graph must be accompanied by an authoring-BLIND or label-shuffled-at-fixed-structure null before it enters the paper. Motivated by: exp_dev's AAA-3 0.94x clique-size catch (the confound is documented, not hypothetical) + the three independence claims above all sharing one authoring pipeline. This is the orthogonality analog of the 11th rule (held-out test for macro-F1 Goodhart).
